title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：profit　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 profit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the shopkeeper ① shared the profit that no buyer in the shop would have recorded, and he said the sharing was the whole of the month. The ② profit, meaning the gain itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; profit, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ item of profit in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ profit at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Profit, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the shopkeeper said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the profit was the whole of the matter, meaning the reward and not the gain. The ⑥ profit, meaning the reward and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; profit, he said, is either something you share or the only word that means both gain and a reward. He said the reward is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ profit had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ profit of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of recording; profit, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ profit I remember is the profit recorded in the account, which closed in 1979 and is still recorded as the quietest in the shop. ⑩ Profit, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all profit, she said, is a reward that has agreed to look like gain. She said the reward was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 利润（指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 利润（指那笔利润本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：share the profit 分这一笔利润
D. n. 利润（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 利润之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的利润之事）
F. n. 利润（指账本里写到、被记载的那一笔）
G. n. 利润、回报（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 回报（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: shared the profit that no buyer in the shop would have recorded
The profit, meaning the gain itself and not the scale
Every item of profit in that shop
the profit at the far counter
the profit was the whole of the matter

answers.why: share the profit 意为“分这一笔利润”，1972 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯记载的一笔利润做了一遍。
profit 意为“利润”，指那笔利润本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
profit 意为“利润”，指铺子里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
profit 意为“利润”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
profit 意为“利润、回报”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔回报就是那件事的全部。
profit 意为“回报”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔利润，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
profit 意为“利润”，指账本里写到、被记载的那一笔，到 1977 年这一笔成了账本里的一行。
profit 意为“利润之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的利润之事是一处铺子和三个月份的记载。
profit 意为“利润”，我记得的是账本里记载过的那一笔，1979 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一笔。
profit 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，利润是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的利润。
